# 4AllPass

4AllPass is a self-hosted zero-knowledge vault. Desktop app is the product. Agents get time-boxed access after Allow/Deny. Canonical: https://netzwerkpunkt.de/4allpass

Hub: https://netzwerkpunkt.de
GitHub: https://github.com/landjunge/4AllPass
Pages: https://landjunge.github.io/4AllPass/
